**Stable ID:** `DATA-02.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 02 Dataset discovery and source inventory

Inventory datasets introduced in academic venues and preprint servers, linked to exact paper revisions.

## Deliverables

- Source inventory of academic venues and archives
- Candidate list with paper-revision links

## Canonical artifact paths

- `research/sources/academic.md`
- `catalog/proposals/`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each candidate cites an exact paper revision or DOI

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inventory lists venues, access method and terms for each
- [ ] Candidates are proposals, not accepted records
- [ ] Paper links follow the papers repository identity rules

## Non-goals

- Copying paper text or figures
- Asserting dataset quality from a paper claim

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-02.02.T1` Inventory venues
  - [ ] `DATA-02.02.T1.S1` List conference and journal dataset tracks
  - [ ] `DATA-02.02.T1.S2` List preprint servers
  - [ ] `DATA-02.02.T1.S3` Record each venue's access terms
- [ ] `DATA-02.02.T2` Collect candidates
  - [ ] `DATA-02.02.T2.S1` Record candidate identity fields only
  - [ ] `DATA-02.02.T2.S2` Link the exact paper revision
  - [ ] `DATA-02.02.T2.S3` Mark unresolved identities

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-02.01` Discovery method and source-use policy
- Blocked by `DATA-04.01` Dataset identifier and publisher model
- Blocks `DATA-07.02`

## Review requirements

- Independent dataset research reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.

## Cross-repository handoffs

- Inbound: `Pick-Your-AI/pick-your-ai-papers` — Paper-revision identifiers for dataset-introducing papers
